title: त्र्यशीत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Markandeya tells how the sage Atri praised King Vainya at his horse sacrifice as the foremost of beings, and Gautama objected; Sanatkumara settled the dispute in Atri's favour, and the king rewarded Atri with great wealth.
summary.kn: ವೈನ್ಯರಾಜನ ಅಶ್ವಮೇಧದಲ್ಲಿ ಅತ್ರಿ ಋಷಿ ಅವನನ್ನು ಸರ್ವಶ್ರೇಷ್ಠನೆಂದು ಹೊಗಳಿದಾಗ ಗೌತಮನು ಆಕ್ಷೇಪಿಸಿದನು; ಸನತ್ಕುಮಾರರು ಅತ್ರಿಯ ಪರವಾಗಿ ತೀರ್ಮಾನಿಸಿದರು, ರಾಜನು ಅತ್ರಿಗೆ ಅಪಾರ ಧನ ನೀಡಿದನು ಎಂದು ಮಾರ್ಕಂಡೇಯರು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: मार्कण्डेय बताते हैं कि ऋषि अत्रि ने राजा वैन्य के अश्वमेध में उन्हें सर्वश्रेष्ठ प्राणी कहकर उनकी स्तुति की, और गौतम ने आपत्ति की; सनत्कुमार ने विवाद अत्रि के पक्ष में सुलझाया, और राजा ने अत्रि को अपार धन दिया।
summary.te: వైన్యరాజు అశ్వమేధంలో అత్రి మహర్షి అతనిని సర్వశ్రేష్ఠుడని కొనియాడగా గౌతముడు అభ్యంతరపెట్టాడని, సనత్కుమారుడు అత్రి పక్షాన తీర్పు చెప్పాడని, రాజు అత్రికి అపార ధనమిచ్చాడని మార్కండేయుడు చెబుతాడు.
summary.ta: வைன்ய மன்னனின் அஶ்வமேதத்தில் அத்ரி முனிவர் அவனை எல்லாரிலும் சிறந்தவன் என்று புகழ, கௌதமர் மறுத்தார்; ஸனத்குமாரர் அத்ரிக்குச் சாதகமாகத் தீர்த்து வைக்க, மன்னன் அத்ரிக்குப் பெருஞ்செல்வம் அளித்தான் என்று மார்க்கண்டேயர் சொல்கிறார்.
summary.ml: അശ്വമേധയാഗത്തിൽ അത്രിമുനി വൈന്യരാജാവിനെ സർവ്വഭൂതങ്ങളിലും ശ്രേഷ്ഠനെന്ന് പുകഴ്ത്തിയതും ഗൗതമൻ എതിർത്തതും മാർക്കണ്ഡേയൻ പറയുന്നു; സനത്കുമാരൻ തർക്കം അത്രിക്ക് അനുകൂലമായി തീർക്കുന്നു, രാജാവ് അത്രിക്ക് വലിയ സമ്പത്ത് നൽകി പ്രതിഫലം നൽകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.183; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

meaning.en: Markandeya said:

verses.text:
भूय एव तु माहात्म्यं ब्राह्मणानां निबोध मे ।
वैन्यो नामेह राजर्षिरश्वमेधाय दीक्षितः ।
तमत्रिर्गन्तुमारेभे वित्तार्थमिति नः श्रुतम् ॥

meaning.en: Hear from me once more of the greatness of brahmins. There was a royal sage here called Vainya, who was consecrated for a horse sacrifice. We have heard that Atri set out to go to him for wealth.

verses.text:
भूयोऽथ नानुरुध्यत्स धर्मव्यक्तिनिदर्शनात् ।
संचिन्त्य स महातेजा वनमेवान्वरोचयत् ।
धर्मपत्नीं समाहूय पुत्रांश्चेदमुवाच ह ॥

meaning.en: Then, seeing the manifest nature of dharma, he was no longer drawn to household life; after reflection, that very radiant sage preferred the forest. Calling his wife and his sons, he said to them,

verses.text:
प्राप्स्यामः फलमत्यन्तं बहुलं निरुपद्रवम् ।
अरण्यगमनं क्षिप्रं रोचतां वो गुणाधिकम् ॥

meaning.en: "We shall obtain a boundless fruit, abundant and free of trouble. Let it please you that we go quickly to the forest, which is higher in virtue."

verses.text:
तं भार्या प्रत्युवाचेदं धर्ममेवानुरुध्यती ।
वैन्यं गत्वा महात्मानमर्थयस्व धनं बहु ।
स ते दास्यति राजर्षिर्यजमानोऽर्थिने धनम् ॥

meaning.en: His wife, who honored only dharma, answered, "Go to the great-souled Vainya and ask for much wealth. That royal sage, who is sacrificing, will give wealth to one who asks.

verses.text:
तत आदाय विप्रर्षे प्रतिगृह्य धनं बहु ।
भृत्यान्सुतान्संविभज्य ततो व्रज यथेप्सितम् ।
एष वै परमो धर्मो धर्मविद्भिरुदाहृतः ॥

meaning.en: Then, brahmin sage, take the much wealth you receive, divide it among your dependents and sons, and go where you wish. This is the highest dharma, as those who know dharma declare."

verses.text: अत्रिरुवाच

meaning.en: Atri said:

verses.text:
कथितो मे महाभागे गौतमेन महात्मना ।
वैन्यो धर्मार्थसंयुक्तः सत्यव्रतसमन्वितः ॥

meaning.en: "Blessed lady, the great-souled Gautama has told me that Vainya is devoted to dharma and wealth and faithful to truth.

verses.text:
किं त्वस्ति तत्र द्वेष्टारो निवसन्ति हि मे द्विजाः ।
यथा मे गौतमः प्राह ततो न व्यवसाम्यहम् ॥

meaning.en: But there are brahmins living there who are hostile to me, as Gautama said, and so I do not resolve to go.

verses.text:
तत्र स्म वाचं कल्याणीं धर्मकामार्थसंहिताम् ।
मयोक्तामन्यथा ब्रूयुस्ततस्ते वै निरर्थकाम् ॥

meaning.en: Whatever auspicious speech I utter there, joined to dharma, desire and wealth, they will twist and so make useless.

verses.text:
गमिष्यामि महाप्राज्ञे रोचते मे वचस्तव ।
गाश्च मे दास्यते वैन्यः प्रभूतं चार्थसंचयम् ॥

meaning.en: Yet I will go, wise lady; your words please me. Vainya will give me cows and a great store of wealth."

verses.text: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

meaning.en: Markandeya said:

verses.text:
एवमुक्त्वा जगामाशु वैन्ययज्ञं महातपाः ।
गत्वा च यज्ञायतनमत्रिस्तुष्टाव तं नृपम् ॥

meaning.en: So saying, the great ascetic quickly went to Vainya's sacrifice, and, reaching the sacrificial ground, Atri praised the king.

verses.text:
राजन्वैन्य त्वमीशश्च भुवि त्वं प्रथमो नृपः ।
स्तुवन्ति त्वां मुनिगणास्त्वदन्यो नास्ति धर्मवित् ॥

meaning.en: "King Vainya, you are lord and the first of kings on earth. Hosts of sages praise you; no one other than you knows dharma."

verses.text:
तमब्रवीदृषिस्तत्र वचः क्रुद्धो महातपाः ।
मैवमत्रे पुनर्ब्रूया न ते प्रज्ञा समाहिता ।
अत्र नः प्रथमं स्थाता महेन्द्रो वै प्रजापतिः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing him, the great ascetic sage Gautama said angrily, "Atri, do not speak so again. Your mind is not composed. Here Mahendra, the Prajapati, stands first among us."

verses.text:
अथात्रिरपि राजेन्द्र गौतमं प्रत्यभाषत ।
अयमेव विधाता च यथैवेन्द्रः प्रजापतिः ।
त्वमेव मुह्यसे मोहान्न प्रज्ञानं तवास्ति ह ॥

meaning.en: Then Atri too, king of kings, replied to Gautama, "This one alone is the creator, as Indra is Prajapati. It is you who are confused by delusion; you have no real understanding."

verses.text: गौतम उवाच

meaning.en: Gautama said:

verses.text:
जानामि नाहं मुह्यामि त्वं विवक्षुर्विमुह्यसे ।
स्तोष्यसेऽभ्युदयप्रेप्सुस्तस्य दर्शनसंश्रयात् ॥

meaning.en: "I know; I am not confused. You, wishing to speak, are the one who is confused. You will praise him wanting prosperity, relying on being seen by him.

verses.text:
न वेत्थ परमं धर्मं न चावैषि प्रयोजनम् ।
बालस्त्वमसि मूढश्च वृद्धः केनापि हेतुना ॥

meaning.en: You do not know the highest dharma and do not understand its purpose. You are a child and a fool, grown old for some reason."

verses.text: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

meaning.en: Markandeya said:

verses.text:
विवदन्तौ तथा तौ तु मुनीनां दर्शने स्थितौ ।
ये तस्य यज्ञे संवृत्तास्तेऽपृच्छन्त कथं त्विमौ ॥

meaning.en: As the two sages disputed this way in the presence of the sages, those who were at his sacrifice asked how it was.

verses.text:
प्रवेशः केन दत्तोऽयमनयोर्वैन्यसंसदि ।
उच्चैः समभिभाषन्तौ केन कार्येण विष्ठितौ ॥

meaning.en: "Who allowed these two into Vainya's assembly? Speaking loudly, what business have they here?"

verses.text:
ततः परमधर्मात्मा काश्यपः सर्वधर्मवित् ।
विवादिनावनुप्राप्तौ तावुभौ प्रत्यवेदयत् ॥

meaning.en: Then Kashyapa, supremely righteous and knowing all dharma, told them of these two who had come in dispute.

verses.text:
अथाब्रवीत्सदस्यांस्तु गौतमो मुनिसत्तमान् ।
आवयोर्व्याहृतं प्रश्नं शृणुत द्विजपुंगवाः ।
वैन्यो विधातेत्याहात्रिरत्र नः संशयो महान् ॥

meaning.en: Then Gautama said to the members of the assembly, the best of sages, "Hear the question put by the two of us, best of brahmins. Atri says Vainya is the creator, and in this we have a great doubt."

verses.text:
श्रुत्वैव तु महात्मानो मुनयोऽभ्यद्रवन्द्रुतम् ।
सनत्कुमारं धर्मज्ञं संशयच्छेदनाय वै ॥

meaning.en: Hearing this, the great-souled sages quickly ran to Sanatkumara, who knows dharma, to have the doubt cut.

verses.text:
स च तेषां वचः श्रुत्वा यथातत्त्वं महातपाः ।
प्रत्युवाचाथ तानेवं धर्मार्थसहितं वचः ॥

meaning.en: Hearing their words as they truly were, that great ascetic answered them with words joined to dharma and wealth.

verses.text: सनत्कुमार उवाच

meaning.en: Sanatkumara said:

verses.text:
ब्रह्म क्षत्रेण सहितं क्षत्रं च ब्रह्मणा सह ।
राजा वै प्रथमो धर्मः प्रजानां पतिरेव च ।
स एव शक्रः शुक्रश्च स धाता स बृहस्पतिः ॥

meaning.en: "The brahmin is joined to the kshatriya, and the kshatriya to the brahmin. The king is the first dharma, and the lord of the people. He alone is Indra and Shukra, he is Dhata and he is Brihaspati.

verses.text:
प्रजापतिर्विराट्सम्राट्क्षत्रियो भूपतिर्नृपः ।
य एभिः स्तूयते शब्दैः कस्तं नार्चितुमर्हति ॥

meaning.en: He is the Prajapati, Viraj, Samrat, Kshatriya, Bhupati and Nripa. Who would not be fit to worship the one praised with these words?

verses.text:
पुरायोनिर्युधाजिच्च अभिया मुदितो भवः ।
स्वर्णेता सहजिद्बभ्रुरिति राजाभिधीयते ॥

meaning.en: He is called king by names such as Purayoni, Yudhajit, Abhiya, Mudita, Bhava, Svarneta, Sahajit and Babhru.

verses.text:
सत्यमन्युर्युधाजीवः सत्यधर्मप्रवर्तकः ।
अधर्मादृषयो भीता बलं क्षत्रे समादधन् ॥

meaning.en: Satyamanyu, Yudhajiva, the promoter of true dharma: the sages, afraid of adharma, placed strength in the kshatriya.

verses.text:
आदित्यो दिवि देवेषु तमो नुदति तेजसा ।
तथैव नृपतिर्भूमावधर्मं नुदते भृशम् ॥

meaning.en: As the sun in heaven among the gods drives out darkness by his brilliance, so the king on earth strongly drives out adharma.

verses.text:
अतो राज्ञः प्रधानत्वं शास्त्रप्रामाण्यदर्शनात् ।
उत्तरः सिध्यते पक्षो येन राजेति भाषितम् ॥

meaning.en: Therefore the king's primacy is seen from the authority of the scriptures; the later side, by which he is called king, is established."

verses.text: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

meaning.en: Markandeya said:

verses.text:
ततः स राजा संहृष्टः सिद्धे पक्षे महामनाः ।
तमत्रिमब्रवीत्प्रीतः पूर्वं येनाभिसंस्तुतः ॥

meaning.en: Then that king, great-minded and delighted that his side was established, said happily to Atri, who had praised him first,

verses.text:
यस्मात्सर्वमनुष्येषु ज्यायांसं मामिहाब्रवीः ।
सर्वदेवैश्च विप्रर्षे संमितं श्रेष्ठमेव च ।
तस्मात्तेऽहं प्रदास्यामि विविधं वसु भूरि च ॥

meaning.en: "Since you called me here the greatest among all men, brahmin sage, and equal to all the gods and the best, I will give you wealth, various and abundant.

verses.text:
दासीसहस्रं श्यामानां सुवस्त्राणामलंकृतम् ।
दश कोट्यो हिरण्यस्य रुक्मभारांस्तथा दश ।
एतद्ददानि ते विप्र सर्वज्ञस्त्वं हि मे मतः ॥

meaning.en: A thousand dark-skinned servant women, with fine garments and adorned, ten crores of gold, and ten loads of gold pieces: I give you this, brahmin, for I consider you all-knowing."

verses.text:
तदत्रिर्न्यायतः सर्वं प्रतिगृह्य महामनाः ।
प्रत्याजगाम तेजस्वी गृहानेव महातपाः ॥

meaning.en: Atri, great-minded, accepted all that properly and went back, radiant, to his own home.

verses.text:
प्रदाय च धनं प्रीतः पुत्रेभ्यः प्रयतात्मवान् ।
तपः समभिसंधाय वनमेवान्वपद्यत ॥

meaning.en: Pleased, he gave the wealth to his sons, and with a disciplined self, resolving on austerity, he went to the forest.
